text: here is a real stupid bug here is a basic cube [Image #102] and im going to select every face and turn on the rotate tool [Image #103] and now rotate it [Image #104] and for whatever reason im getting unsafe eddit, 8 triangles collapsed. ???? what
resolution: Fixed the false 'Unsafe face edit' on whole-selection rotates. Root cause: countUnsafeFaceEdits (framework/gpu/3d.zig) flagged a triangle as flipped when its after-normal pointed >~93deg away from its before-normal — but a rigid rotation swings every normal with it, so rotating a fully-selected cube far enough made 8/12 triangles read as flipped despite zero degeneration. Fix: a face whose three edge lengths survived the drag moved rigidly (rotate/translate of a full selection), and a proper rigid motion cannot flip or collapse a triangle — such faces are exempt from the flip test (2e-3 relative tolerance absorbs float drift from incremental per-mousemove rotation). Genuinely distorted faces (partial selections dragged through themselves) are still flagged. Needs a Zig rebuild to take effect.
